behaviors.description: The key and its value are no longer kept, and the answer is deleted. A key that is not kept is not found, and nothing changes.
behaviors.name: Delete

otherwise.does: The answer is every key with its value, in the order the keys were first put. Nothing changes.

The value (any JSON value, null included) is kept under the key. A key that is already kept keeps its place and gets the new value; a new key goes after the others. A key that was deleted is new when it is put again. Keys are compared exactly, as strings.

descriptions.component: Keeps JSON values by key. What it keeps survives a restart.
descriptions.data.entries: What is kept, in the order the keys were first put.

entriesAfterDelete.description: The entries without the one kept under the key, the others keeping their order.

entriesAfterPut.description: The entries with the value under the key: if the key is already kept, its entry keeps its place and gets the new value; otherwise a new entry with the key and the value goes after the others.
